primary_socket.coordinate_space: existing rig local units; initial READY target, phase-specific source artist alignment required
primary_socket.source_pixels_status: OPEN until the actual requested state is authored; do not invent anatomy to meet a coordinate

requests.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. Neutral exports cannot substitute for movement/strike/hurt/defeat; an asymmetric view cannot be mirrored; source palms and support layers cannot be invented.
requests.weapon_contract: Exact family-specific export; a baked weapon must be declared and restricted. Otherwise deliver intact weaponless hands and separate equipment layers.
requests.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requests.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requests.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requests.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

occupied_bounds.rule: Full silhouette inside these bounds; match per-ID proportions and existing ground target, not a stretched square.
